high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post featuring information about Athangudi tiles used in a project called Vanaalaya. The post includes text and four attached pictures showcasing the use of these tiles. The text explains that Athangudi tiles have been incorporated into the sit outs and courtyards of Vanaalaya, which is the current project. These tiles are eco-friendly, handmade floor tiles named after the village of Athangudi where they originate and are made. Athangudi is located in the Chettinad Area of Tamil Nadu.
